metadata.description: Meaningfy company-wide skills, agents, methodologies, and engineering standards for working with LLM agents consistently

plugins.name: meaningfy-core
plugins.description: Cross-cutting basics everyone installs: clear technical writing, explanatory-writing craft, the writing antipatterns catalogue, the Meaningfy company voice, the Meaningfy git/PR workflow, agentic guardrails, how to report a skill or agent problem to skillery, your own rules for agents: load, learn and groom them (rulebook, rule-learner, rule-steward), and working from a repository of house material by its own rules (corpus-repository)

plugins.name: meaningfy-consulting
plugins.description: The advisory role: semantic-technologies coaching, the Decision Package, and executive communication

plugins.name: meaningfy-sales
plugins.description: The commercial role: proposal and offer writing, and estimation

plugins.name: meaningfy-architecture
plugins.description: The design / modelling role: system architecture (C4, ArchiMate/UML, ADRs, contracts), the living conceptual model, the shared modelling conventions, and the LinkML craft (LinkML → typed artefacts + OWL/SHACL)

plugins.name: meaningfy-building
plugins.description: The delivery / developer role: the spine build loop (epic-planning, spec-stewardship, clarity-gate, BDD, code review), clean layered Python (cosmic-python), repo scaffolding (project-setup), CD/deploy (ci-cd-delivery), and the release lifecycle (meaningfy-release)

plugins.name: meaningfy-devops
plugins.description: The operations role: provision and change servers as code (infrastructure-operations), run and deploy stacks (stack-operations), monitor, check daily, answer incidents and back up (service-reliability), and keep access and secrets safe (infrastructure-security); with an interactive devops agent, an unattended watch and an infrastructure reviewer

plugins.name: meaningfy-legal
plugins.description: The legal role: draft, revise and align contracts and propose clause changes in your own contract repository (contract-practice), with Tolic the lawyer, a lead who works there with you and never sends, signs or registers without your confirmation

plugins.name: vault-assistant
plugins.description: The workflow bundle for people who keep a personal Obsidian vault: set it up (vault-setup), write notes one way (vault-conventions), run projects from charter to archive (vault-project, vault-resume, vault-capture), curate (vault-promote, vault-tidy), and keep a rhythm of plans and a morning note (vault-planning, vault-daily). Needs the external obsidian@obsidian-skills plugin and the company memory

plugins.name: meaningfy-navigator
plugins.description: See who runs what and where the work stands in Claude Code: a status line and band over the session, workflow and plan drift warnings, hygiene prompts, and actions that run your own commands (Claude Code only, CLI and desktop)
